tasks.title: Ensure all tests pass
tasks.description:
Run the test suite (npm test) to identify any failing tests. Read the test output carefully. If any tests fail:
1. Read the failing test files (src/App.test.tsx, src/components/Button.test.tsx, src/components/Display.test.tsx, src/components/Calculator.test.tsx)
2. Read the corresponding source files being tested
3. Fix either the test code or source code to make tests pass
4. Verify all tests pass with npm test

The project uses vitest for testing. Recent history shows QA validation tasks failing, indicating tests may still be broken. Investigate and fix all failures.
acceptance_criteria: All test files pass: App.test.tsx, Button.test.tsx, Display.test.tsx, Calculator.test.tsx
No test failures, errors, or warnings in output

tasks.title: Validate all tests pass
tasks.description:
Run the complete test suite using npm test. Verify that:
1. The command exits with code 0
2. All test files execute successfully
3. No failures, errors, or warnings appear in the output

Report the test results clearly.
